mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bank_risk_results WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_risk_results WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
SELECT task_id AS "task_id", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM bank_risk_results WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) GROUP BY task_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_risk_results SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
UPDATE bank_risk_results SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_risk_results WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM bank_risk_results WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_risk_results SET indicators = #{indicators}::jsonb, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, edit_state = #{editState}::jsonb WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE bank_risk_results SET indicators = (edit_state -> 'original_indicators')::jsonb, risk_level = (edit_state ->> 'original_risk_level')::int, edit_state = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND edit_state IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_risk_results ( task_id, section_id, section_name, region_code, bank_id, run_time, risk_level, indicators, geom, run_id, user_id, edit_state, source_task_id) SELECT #{newTaskId}, ns.section_id, r.section_name, r.region_code, r.bank_id, r.run_time, r.risk_level, r.indicators, r.geom, r.run_id, #{targetUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, r.edit_state, r.task_id FROM bank_risk_results r JOIN cross_sections os ON os.section_id = r.section_id AND os.task_id = #{srcTaskId} JOIN cross_sections ns ON ns.task_id = #{newTaskId} AND ns.section_id = 'sec-' || #{newTaskId} || CASE WHEN os.section_id LIKE #{srcPrefix} || '%' THEN substring(os.section_id FROM char_length(#{srcPrefix}) + 1) ELSE '-copy-' || os.id END WHERE r.task_id = #{srcTaskId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.id
